images.actual_source_analysis: A transparent curved-roof bus shelter occupies the left-middle foreground, with black metal supports and a simple empty slatted bench inside. Bare branches and dark hedges fill the background; the shelter has small cool highlights and reflections. No bus sign, advertisement panel, people or vehicles are visible.
